concept_a.prompt: Create a high-fidelity UI concept image for a Google TV app called Postbox, for reviewing Twitter/X and Instagram posts saved from an Android phone. Art direction: warm near-black #131817 canvas, soft ivory typography, desaturated sage surfaces, restrained warm apricot focus ring, precise spacious native-TV layout. Premium editorial reading tool, understated, no sci-fi gradients, no glassmorphism. TV couch distance: large text, generous spacing, strong contrast, safe outer margins about 5%. Header: simple native bookmark symbol and Postbox at left, two calm tabs Saved and Archive toward center, large '+ Add posts' button at upper right. Main body: left 36% column headed 'Saved · 3'. A vertical list of THREE large cards: first card focused with a very obvious apricot outline and subtle scale, X source marker, title 'Small habits, lasting change', secondary label 'Saved text'. Second card Instagram marker, title 'A quieter place', secondary label 'Screenshot'. Third card X marker, title 'A post to revisit', secondary label 'Link only'. Footer lower left simple '↑ ↓ Choose a post    OK Read    Back Exit'. Lower right 20% is quiet for independent clock overlay. Visually communicate a focused library and one selected post, NOT endless social media. All text crisp and correctly spelled. Compose-feasible native shapes and typography.
